notes.title: v1.11
notes.content:
Improved casting slash beam experience
- Fixed slash beam immediately casting upon touching first node, happens often.

- It will now be easier to cancel diagonal, vertical, horizontal slash beam casting. Do it by moving the greatsword out of the nodes path.

It should be easier to spam horizontal slash beams now in this update.

It should be easier to spam horizontal slash beams now in this update.

notes.title: v1.08 - Fixed 'null' error for slash beam.
notes.content:
Fixed 'null' error when casting slash beams at more than visual 0.99 value.
Fixed 'Screen Resolution Ratio' missing in Gameplay Settings for Android only.
Fixed target FPS for Android, 'No Limit' or value more than 60, will be set to 60 fps.

notes.title: v1.07 - Slash Beams are now easier to cast
notes.content:
- Removed Slash Beam fail mechanic.
- Can still cancel Slash Beam casting by tracing backwards or just moving greatsword to face backwards.
- Slash Beams commands now has 2 nodes instead of 3.
- Will now cast Slash Beam upon the greatsword exiting the final node, while the visual slash beam fill value is > 75%.
- Will now cast Slash Beam upon visual slash beam fill value > 99%.

tags.balance_change: - Slash Beams commands now has 2 nodes instead of 3.

- Will now cast Slash Beam upon visual slash beam fill value > 99%.
